lock_effect: Both boards render one density step tighter everywhere; the brand package's default density is unchanged for every other surface — this is a boards-local mutation, not a package change.

mutations.change: Cluster gap steps down from --cluster-gap (1.25rem) to --space-4 (1rem) between board sections.
Row vertical padding steps down from --space-3 to --space-2; row text stays at the standard body size and line height.
Interactive targets do NOT shrink with density: minimum target stays --target-min (1.5rem), touch target stays --target-touch (2.75rem) per the package accessibility section.

summary: Boards-only density step: cluster gap and row padding tighten one step on the package's space scale so a full board (200+ PR rows) scans on one screen, while touch targets stay at the package minimum.
